RTF is an older Microsoft format that supports rich formatting such as bold and italic text, font changes, and more. About RTF Parsing The viewer extracts plain text from RTF files, stripping all formatting control words. Special characters are handled via Windows-1252 encoding, so café and résumé appear correctly.
